title: iPhone 17 Pro is Vulnerable to Scratching, But Not Where You Might Think
summary: Durability testing found the sharp anodised edges of the camera plateau scuff easily, while the rest of the aluminium body resisted scratches well.

title: Apple responds to iPhone 17 Pro scratch and durability concerns
summary: Apple said marks on in-store demo units were material transferred from worn MagSafe stands and can be cleaned off, and that the aluminium camera plateau can show small abrasions over time.

title: iPhone 17 Pro Max durability test: Scratchgate is Apple's fault
summary: JerryRigEverything's durability test blamed the camera-plateau scuffing on design: the plateau's edges have no chamfer or radius, so the anodised coating adheres poorly there.

findings.subject: apple-iphone-17-pro-max
findings.text: The camera plateau's sharp, unchamfered edges are the weak point for scuffs. The flat body and back resisted scratches well.

title: iPhone 17 aces durability test
summary: The base iPhone 17 came through JerryRigEverything's scratch, burn and bend tests well, helped by its Ceramic Shield 2 front glass.

title: OPPO Find X9 Series Launches Globally, Redefining Flagship Experience with 200MP Hasselblad Telephoto, 7000+mAh Battery, Top-Tier Performance, and ColorOS 16
summary: OPPO's press release announcing the global launch of the Find X9 series with a 200 MP Hasselblad telephoto and 7,000+ mAh batteries.

title: OnePlus 15 with 6.78″ 1.5K 165Hz AMOLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, 7300mAh battery announced
summary: China launch of the OnePlus 15 from CNY 3,999, with a 165 Hz display, 7,300 mAh battery and 120 W wired charging.

title: realme GT8 and GT8 Pro with 6.79″ 2K 144Hz OLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, up to 200MP telephoto camera, 7000mAh battery announced
summary: China launch of the realme GT 8 Pro from CNY 3,999, with a RICOH GR camera system and 200 MP periscope.

title: Honor Magic 8 Pro will reportedly have battery downgraded by 13% in Europe
summary: Reported ahead of the European launch: the EU Magic8 Pro ships with a smaller battery than other markets. GSMArena's EU test unit had 6,270 mAh against 7,100 mAh globally.

title: Honor Magic 8 Pro Goes Global: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, 200MP Camera and More
summary: The HONOR Magic8 Pro's international rollout begins in Malaysia.

title: RedMagic 11 Pro brings its liquid cooling to the global stage
summary: Global availability from $669 / €669, on sale from 18 November, in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and the Middle East.

title: Google Pixel 10 will soon get a GPU driver update
summary: After reports of stutter in demanding games linked to an outdated GPU driver, Google confirmed that driver updates for the Pixel 10 series were coming.

title: Pixel 10 Gets A Hidden Performance Upgrade — What The New Graphics Driver Really Delivers
summary: Hands-on testing of the updated Tensor G5 GPU driver reported measurable gains in some games, though Pixel 10 gaming performance still trails rival flagships.

title: iQOO 15 with 6.85″ 2K LTPO 144Hz OLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, 7000mAh battery launched in India
summary: India launch from ₹72,999 for 12 GB / 256 GB.

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Is Now Official; Retails From RM6,799
summary: Launch-day Malaysian pricing: from RM6,799 for the models on sale then. The 12 GB / 256 GB model, listed as coming soon at launch, is RM5,999 (see the device's prices).

title: Samsung confirms the Galaxy S26 Ultra price starts at $1,299
summary: US pricing starts at $1,299.99 for 256 GB, unchanged from the S25 Ultra.

title: Exynos 2600 runs neck-and-neck with Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 in post-launch Geekbench tests
summary: Early Geekbench listings put the Exynos 2600 close to the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 in multi-core, but behind in single-core.

title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra hands-on: Incredible cameras, but maybe hard to get
summary: Global launch at MWC 2026, with UK pricing from £1,299. US availability was not confirmed.

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 with Exynos 2600 shows many disadvantages compared to Snapdragon
summary: Tests of European Exynos units found the S26 and S26+ slower than their US Snapdragon counterparts in several workloads, and drawing more power.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8: Release Date, Features & Specs
summary: Samsung's guide to the Z Fold8, unveiled at Galaxy Unpacked on 22 July 2026, with a wider 4:3 main display and 5.5-inch cover screen.

title: Google Pixel 11 Pro series debuts with Tensor G6, new cameras and Qi2.2 charging
author: Anil Ganti
summary: Pixel 11 Pro ($1,099) and Pro XL ($1,299) announced with Tensor G6, 3,600-nit displays, Qi2.2 magnetic charging and seven years of updates.

title: One UI 9 Beta 6 arrives early for Galaxy S26 series with four impressive upgrades
summary: The sixth One UI 9 (Android 17) beta reached the Galaxy S26 series ahead of schedule.

title: Samsung Announces One UI 9 Beta Feature Update for Galaxy S26 series
summary: Samsung brought features from its latest foldables to One UI 9 beta testers on the Galaxy S26 series, rolling out from 28 August.

title: Galaxy S26 Ultra Gets a Surprise One UI 9 Beta Hotfix
summary: An Ultra-only hotfix for the One UI 9 beta while the stable release is still pending.

title: Samsung confirms stable Galaxy S26 One UI 9 update is coming soon
summary: Samsung says the stable One UI 9 (Android 17) release for the S26 series is coming soon, without a firm date.

title: Apple debuts iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
summary: A20 Pro on a 2 nm process, a variable-aperture 48 MP main camera, up to 45 hours of video playback on the Pro Max, from $1,299. Available from 18 September.

title: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max Benchmarks Reveal Speed of A20 Pro Chip
summary: Pre-release Geekbench results suggest roughly 20–28% CPU gains and a much faster GPU than the A19 Pro. They come from prototypes, so treat them as provisional.

title: Wider One UI 9 rollout starts for the Galaxy S26 series
author: Abhijeet Mishra
summary: The stable One UI 9 (Android 17) update, first released in South Korea on 16 September, is now reaching other countries, starting with US carrier models. Other regions are expected over the coming days or weeks.

title: Samsung hikes Galaxy S26 series price in India
author: Abid Iqbal Shaik
summary: A leaked retailer notice shows Indian prices of the S26, S26+ and S26 Ultra rising by INR 15,000 to 25,000 from 23 September; Samsung gave no reason, and SamMobile suspects memory chip costs. India only: Malaysian prices on this site are unchanged.

title: Motorola's new Signature 27 is among the first smartphone to use the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 processor
author: Lawrence Bonk
summary: Motorola's new flagship pairs the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 with a 50 MP main camera, a telephoto upgraded to 200 MP, Bang & Olufsen speakers and seven years of Android upgrades. Price, display details and a release date were not announced.

title: Apple confirms iPhone 18 Pro Max AT&T cellular issues, affected devices require hardware replacement
author: Chance Miller
summary: Apple confirmed that some iPhone 18 Pro Max units on AT&T in the US lose cellular service and show SOS. iOS 27.0.1 and a carrier settings update prevent it on phones not yet affected; a phone that has already lost service needs a hardware replacement through Apple or AT&T. The iPhone 18 Pro, which uses Apple's own modem, is not affected.

title: AT&T and Apple Just Took Steps Toward Fixing iPhone 18 Pro Max Issue
author: Joe Rossignol
summary: Apple released AT&T carrier settings 72.1 and now requires iOS 27.0.1 when setting up the phone; AT&T said it is working with Apple. The update was described as a mitigation rather than a complete fix, and some users reported it turns off 5G Standalone.

title: iPhone 18 Pro Owners Complain of Speaker Crackling or Popping
author: Juli Clover
summary: Some owners on the MacRumors forums and Reddit hear crackling, popping or clicking from the earpiece speaker, constantly or during actions such as scrolling, notifications or calls. Apple had not commented; iOS 27.0.1 did not address it, and some replacement units showed it too. The cause, software or hardware, is not known.

title: iFixit teardown of the new AirPods 5 reveals first real repairability improvement
author: Marcus Mendes
summary: iFixit gave the AirPods 5 a repairability score of 2 out of 10, the first AirPods above zero: the earbud batteries can be replaced by a skilled repairer without destroying the earbud (left and right are not interchangeable). The rest of each earbud is still glued, and the charging case still can't be repaired.

title: Honor 600S 5G Malaysia: Snapdragon 4 Gen 4, 50MP camera and 8,100mAh battery, priced at RM1,299
summary: On sale in Malaysia from 14 October at RM1,299 (256 GB), with a launch bundle of an RM100 rebate and a second year of warranty. It uses the entry-level Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 with 4 GB of RAM (the advertised 12 GB counts 8 GB of virtual RAM), a 6.87-inch HD+ screen, an 8,100 mAh battery with 45 W charging, IP68/IP69/IP69K ratings and a 2.5 m drop claim.

title: Oppo Find X10 Series launching in Malaysia on 22 October, pre-order promo now live
summary: The Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max launch in Malaysia on 22 October; Malaysian prices were not yet announced. An RM200 Deal Pack (8 to 22 October) is credited back when the phone is paid for between 22 and 29 October, but does not guarantee stock. Malaysian versions: Find X10 with 12 GB RAM and 256 or 512 GB; Find X10 Pro Max with 16 GB RAM and 512 GB.

title: HONOR X9e Pro goes through Military Bootcamp and survives ahead of Malaysia release
summary: HONOR Malaysia staged its own durability demonstrations (drops, mud, paint impacts, five minutes underwater) before the 9 October Malaysian release from RM1,899. These are the maker's demonstrations, not independent tests; HONOR claims drop resistance up to 3 m and IP68, IP69 and IP69K ratings.

title: Apple rolls out AT&T carrier update for iPhone 18 Pro Max on iOS 27.2 beta
author: Marcus Mendes
summary: After last week's fix for iOS 27.0 (carrier settings 72.1), Apple released carrier settings 72.0.3 for iPhone 18 Pro Max owners on AT&T who run the iOS 27.2 beta. Only the 18 Pro Max, which uses a Qualcomm modem in the US, is affected; phones that already lost service still need a hardware replacement.

title: Galaxy S26 series gets October 2026 security update
author: Abid Iqbal Shaik
summary: The first update after One UI 9.0 brings the October 2026 security patch (62 fixes) to the Galaxy S26, S26+ and S26 Ultra, starting in Canada and the US with more countries to follow. No date has been given for One UI 9.5.

title: Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 Score 4/10 for Repairability
summary: iFixit scored both watches 4 out of 10 for repairability. The Series 12 gains a pull tab for its battery adhesive and drops a fiddly connector, but the battery still sits behind the display; the Ultra 4 is unchanged. Battery capacities rose to 2.444 Wh (Ultra 4) and 1.461 Wh (46 mm Series 12). iFixit gave the Pixel Watch 5 a 9 out of 10.

title: Pixel 11 series still not on Android 17 QPR1 with October update
author: Abner Li
summary: Older Pixels received Android 17 QPR1 in September, but the Pixel 11 series' October update keeps it on the base Android 17 release. The update does fix an on-screen keyboard that sometimes failed to appear and photos or videos saved in the wrong orientation.

title: Nothing OS 5.0 update rolls out starting with Nothing Phone (3)
author: Srivatsan Sridhar
summary: The stable Nothing OS 5.0 (Android 17) update is rolling out in phases, starting with the Phone (3), with other Nothing and CMF phones to follow over the coming months. Nothing lists more than 80 changes, including a redesigned home screen and lock-screen clock and new on-device AI tools.

title: iPhone Duo Will Have Day-One iOS 27.1 Update
summary: The iPhone Duo runs iOS 27.1, a version only for the foldable, and Apple has already released a newer build, so buyers will install an update during setup. Pre-orders open on 16 October and the phone goes on sale on 23 October.

title: Galaxy A57 owners may want to avoid upgrading to One UI 9.0 right now
author: Mihai Matei
summary: Some Galaxy A57 owners reported that the phone failed to start normally after installing One UI 9.0. Owners found that starting once in Safe Mode and then restarting normally gets past the error; Samsung had not commented.

title: Report: Apple cuts iPhone 18 Pro production due to 'soft demand'
author: Chance Miller
summary: A Nikkei Asia report, citing unnamed supply-chain sources, says Apple cut October component orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max by 15 to 20% after the US$100 price rise softened demand. Apple has not confirmed it; its next quarterly results are due on 2 November.

title: 苹果 iPhone 18 Pro/Max 测试：无可变电压供电充电器也能接近满速快充
summary: IT Home reports LTT Labs' charging test: a USB PD charger without AVS (UGREEN Nexode 140W) charged the iPhone 18 Pro as fast as Apple's 40W Dynamic adapter. On the 18 Pro Max, Apple's adapter peaked near 50 W and filled it in 82 minutes, against 84 minutes with the UGREEN charger, which stayed below 50 W.

title: What Samsung fans are saying about Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra battery life
summary: Owner reports on Reddit (not tests): upgraders from older Folds describe 8 to 9 hours of screen-on time from the Fold 8 Ultra's 5,000 mAh battery, the first capacity rise since the Fold 3, and similar results from the Fold 8's 4,800 mAh. One owner coming from an iPhone 17 Pro Max was less impressed, and SamMobile found it does not last as long as the Galaxy S26 Ultra.
